ideas.question: To determine whether SUID cases differ from other infant deaths regarding maternal smoking during pregnancy and preterm birth status.
ideas.comparison: Sudden unexpected infant death (SUID) cases vs. other causes of infant death, using data from the NCFRP case series for both outcome groups; CDC natality for population at risk; PRAMS Phase 8 ARF for exposure prevalence among live births
ideas.why_open: Maternal smoking and preterm birth are established risk factors for SUID but may not be unique. Identifying specific differences between outcomes would clarify prevention priorities.
ideas.data: Outcome: Sudden unexpected infant death (SUID) vs. other causes of infant death; Exposure: Maternal smoking during pregnancy, Preterm birth status; Population at risk: All live births; Prevalence: Surveyed mothers' responses on maternal smoking and gestational age.
